name: Tokyo Romantica ~Ai wa Megane to Tomo ni~
original_name: 東京ロマンチカ ～愛は眼鏡と共に～
source:
Two boys decide to organize a junk shop. They are in for a lot of fun, but also for the hell of deliveries.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
兩個男孩決定經營一家舊貨店。他們會經歷許多快樂，也會遭遇送貨地獄。
